name: What factors influence the durability and lifespan of new interior flooring?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the durability and lifespan of new interior flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several factors influence the durability and lifespan of your new interior flooring, including the material type, the quality of installation, and how well it's maintained. Hardwood and high-quality tile can last decades with proper care. Engineered wood and luxury vinyl are also very durable. Proper subfloor preparation, correct installation techniques, and regular cleaning, along with avoiding excessive moisture and heavy impact, are crucial for maximizing your floor's longevity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Durability depends on material type, installation quality, and maintenance. Proper subfloor prep, correct techniques, and regular cleaning are key to extending lifespan.
